definitions.effective_journal: A posted journal that is not itself a reversal and has no posted reversal journal.
definitions.report_currency: INR for the current India pilot. Trial balance and profit and loss use functional ledger amounts; party aging and customer activity admit only canonical INR source documents.
definitions.trial_balance_opening: Functional debit minus functional credit before date_from.
definitions.trial_balance_period: Functional debit and functional credit from date_from through date_to inclusive.
definitions.trial_balance_closing: Opening signed balance plus period debit minus period credit.
definitions.profit_loss_income: For accounts canonically classified income, period transaction credit minus transaction debit.
definitions.profit_loss_expense: For accounts canonically classified expense, period transaction debit minus transaction credit.
definitions.profit_loss_result: Income minus expense for the exact inclusive period.
definitions.customer_billed_activity: Count and grand total of posted sales invoices in the exact inclusive invoice-date period and authorized branch scope. It is not cash collection, lifetime value, retention, or net revenue.
definitions.party_aging: Positive unsettled principal of posted receivable or payable open items as of the organization's current business date, after effective posted allocations, grouped into fixed due-date buckets. Account lifecycle status does not erase debt.

explicitly_unavailable: cash-flow classification without an effective-dated canonical mapping
customer churn or lifecycle classification without reviewed policy
collection efficiency without a reviewed denominator and target definition
profitability by product without reviewed cost-allocation policy
